title: What a page tells the editor shell v1 (editor.model.v1)
about: The world an engine page has open, as the editor shell draws it (GitHub #13416): its ID, lane and revision, the steps that can be undone and redone, the selected entity, the columns an edit may set, the kinds, the entities and their kinds' content cells, and the last refusal in words. The page's realm writes it; the shell reads it. It never leaves the page.
